name: keep-lanternfield-lit
description: Keep Lanternfield Lit: a real-time maintenance-management game in one HTML file

scripts.test: npm run build:check && npm run test:engine && npm run test:browser

scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/smoke.js && node tests/browser/layout.js && node tests/browser/saves.js && node tests/browser/motion.js && node tests/browser/ui-motion.js && node tests/browser/sound.js && node tests/browser/perf.js && node tests/browser/dusk.js && node tests/browser/final-screen.js && node tests/browser/playtest.js && node tests/browser/seats.js && node tests/browser/coach.js
scripts.test:slow: node tests/browser/real-day.js && node tests/browser/coach.js sup,tech --phone && node tests/browser/coach.js sup --desk
